what: ADC-3 council suggestion of (Y1219, S1347) as a cross-NBD dimer-closure positive control, <15.0 A C-alpha closure bound on (W401, H1348), >=21-codon control gap on R450, and F931 as a high-s_kin gating hinge control
why: Halted before any test variant was scored: Y1219 (NBD2 A-loop) and S1347 (NBD2 LSHGH) both reside inside NBD2 (d_5UAK = 32.4198 A -> d_6MSM = 31.9376 A, intra-domain), (W401, H1348) closes across the ATP ring to 16.1826 A (> 15.0 A), R450 sits 5 codons from A455E, and external lipid-facing TM8 F931 moves inside a locally quasi-rigid helix bundle (s_kin = 0.1585); calibrated the non-benchmark positive controls in done.md to true cross-NBD ATP Site 1 (K464, H1348: 32.5927 -> 10.9161 A) and Site 2 (T582, G1246: 23.5583 -> 7.8865 A) pairs plus cytosolic gating/catalytic {E267, S1347, H1348, E1371} vs corrector/beta-core {W361, R450, R1102} prior to test evaluation.

what: Modulator-free conformational reorganization s_kin(i) = 1 - lDDT_sym(i; 5UAK, 6MSM) on held-out test partial-processing NBD1 variant A455E vs folding core mutant V520F
why: 1 of 30 missense test pairs was discordant (29/30 = 0.966667): KALYDECO-responsive Class V/II partial-processing variant A455E (NBD1 Walker-A flank, s_kin = 12/73 = 0.164384) scored slightly below KALYDECO-non-responsive NBD1 core mutant V520F (s_kin = 43/228 = 0.188596), whereas TM12 pore-lining D1152H (which missed 2 pairs under static 8EIQ pocket distance in PRED-0011) cleanly separated above all 6 non-responsive test missense variants (s_kin = 9/32 = 0.281250).

what: Modulator-free conformational reorganization s_kin on the 10-variant Lasso_N_terminal / TMD1 / R_domain train split (missense conditional ROC-AUC = 0.500000, 6/12 pairs)
why: While s_kin cleanly scored ECL1 outer-pore R117H (0.613095) and ICL1 gating G178R (0.636029) above TM1 G85E (0.145833) and TM6 R347P (0.250000), mild residual-trafficking variants P67L (Lasso, 0.140625) and L206W (TM3, 0.075581) sit in locally rigid transmembrane scaffolding yet respond to ivacaftor via residual apical expression, and non-responsive TM6 outer-pore charge-loss mutant R334W undergoes large gating reorganization (0.511364) yet abolishes electrostatic anion conduction rather than gating.
